metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a standalone C++20 LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It accepts `--input` and `--output`, supports `inspect` and `render`, validates LAS 1.4 headers/VLRs/EVLRs/CRS records/point formats 0-10/waveform-related records/extra-bytes metadata, and returns structured JSON or the required error shape.

I built it with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` and ran an end-to-end smoke test: render a minimal LAS 1.4 dataset, then inspect the generated LAS back into JSON. That round-trip succeeded.
